name: Coordinate Rectification for Point Cloud Rendering
definition: A method to determine the 3D surface position of a point cloud ray intersection by correcting the depth value based on the angle between the viewing ray and the scene's z-axis, enabling photorealistic rendering from discrete points.
summary: Coordinate Rectification estimates precise 3D surface positions from sparse point clouds by correcting depth values based on viewing angles, unlike standard depth buffering that assumes planar intersections.
